entries.name: com.apple.DwellControl
entries.note: Dwell Control is built: Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Dwell Control sets a delay (Off, 0.5 s, 1 s, 2 s). The shell input loop (bin/shell.rs) clicks a pointer that rests inside the radius for that delay, with no button held. Model: shell/accessibility/dwell.rs (the old duplicate shell/dwell.rs was removed). Needs a Midget check before it counts as parity.
entries.ready_note: Dwell Control: Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Dwell Control picks the delay (accessibility/mod.rs, pages.rs DwellControl, settings.rs Pick::Dwell). bin/shell.rs feeds each resting pointer sample to accessibility::dwell::DwellClick and injects a press and release where it rests. The pure model and the settings round trip are tested; pointer behaviour needs a Midget check.

entries.name: com.apple.GamePolicyAgent
entries.note: Partial: the shell's Game Mode (springboard/src/shell/gamemode.rs) enters when a game is in front full screen (Games category or game = true), leaves after 3 s, and while on: CPU profile Performance, the game's nice and uclamp raised through bifrostd (priority socket), the background task scheduler paused, a menu bar item with Turn Off Game Mode, and a one-time notice. Full screen for app windows is the green button or ToShell::SetFullScreen. Not built: file indexing pause (no indexer runs in the shell), Bluetooth sniff interval (no mgmt connection update), and no framework API for apps to read the state.
entries.ready_note: gamemode.rs enters Game Mode for a full-screen game and leaves after 3 s; tests cover the enter and leave rules.

entries.name: com.apple.KeyboardAccessAgent

Slow Keys is Settings > Keyboard > Slow Keys (shell/slow_keys.rs). Repeat Keys is the key auto-repeat in hwkeys.rs (Settings > Keyboard > Key Repeat). Mouse Keys is a switch (shell/mouse_keys.rs): the keypad moves the pointer with acceleration and the 5 key clicks; 0 and the decimal point are not used for hold and release yet.
entries.ready_note: Keyboard access: Sticky Keys (shell/sticky_keys.rs, hwkeys tests), Slow Keys (shell/slow_keys.rs), Repeat Keys (hwkeys.rs KeyRepeat) and Mouse Keys (shell/mouse_keys.rs), with the settings round trips in accessibility::tests. Needs a Midget check of the keypad and the switches.

entries.name: com.apple.cfnetwork.AuthBrokerAgent
entries.note: Missing: test coverage for the authentication challenge answer in url_background.rs (answer_challenge). Built 2026-10-17: the answer has tests (stored credential, delegate credential kept or not kept, declined challenge, Digest not answered with Basic); tests url_background::tests. Credential storage is in http_auth.rs.
entries.ready_note: Challenge answering for URL sessions (url_background.rs answer_challenge) and the per-host credential store (http_auth.rs URLCredentialStorage) cover the broker job; both are tested in the bifrost-app crate.

entries.name: com.apple.coreservices.UASharedPasteboardProgressUI
entries.note: Pasteboard contents and Wayland offers (shell/pasteboard.rs). The transfer model and the overlay are built (shell/pasteboard_transfer.rs): byte progress, a 600 ms delay before the panel, and a bar at the top of the screen. The clipboard service reports each write's size. Not built: a transfer that lasts long enough to show, because the service hands payloads over in one call; the panel needs chunked hand-over. The shared clipboard from another device is not built.

entries.name: com.apple.coreservices.sharedfilelistd
entries.note: Recent apps are built (shell/recent_items.rs on the shared list model). Missing: the shared favourites list. The model with favourites and its text store exist in bifrost-ui (shared_list, shared_list_store), but no shell surface or app reads favourites. Built 2026-10-17: favourites on the recents list (recent_items set_favourite and favourite_apps; favourites are kept past the recents cap); tests shell::recent_items::tests. Built 2026-10-17: recents and favourites are saved to recent-items.txt in the settings directory and read back by set_data_dir (recent_items::load and save; tests shell::recent_items::tests). Still missing: a surface that shows the favourites.

entries.name: com.apple.coreservices.useractivityd

Built 2026-10-17: the activity model (sdk/src/user_activity.rs, ActivityCenter) with one current activity per type, resume state, continuation by another app and search eligibility; tests user_activity::tests. Not wired: the shell does not route a continuation to the other app yet.

entries.name: com.apple.csuseragent
entries.note: The initramfs hook unlocks the encrypted system volume at boot. After login, the shell lists the LUKS volumes with no open mapping (core volume_unlock.rs) and shows the password sheet for each (shell/volume_sheet.rs). The sheet sends the passphrase to privd's disk.unlock_volume (privd/disk.rs), which opens the volume with cryptsetup and mounts it with udisksctl. A failed unlock asks again; Cancel leaves the volume locked for the session.
entries.ready_note: Unlock after login: core model, privd disk.unlock_volume (refusals and command lines tested), and the shell sheet (prompt and queue tested). Needs a Midget check with a real LUKS volume.
